electric motor start is represented by its accepted low-power throttle/RPM rise

accepted_stage_spans.meaning: Each observed phase is reported per session epoch so fixture resets do not merge unrelated tick/time ranges. Wall spans use monotonic capture time; sequence spans advance from accepted FlightSession ticks.

glow_generator.meaning: AudioStreamGeneratorPlayback.get_skips() readings are sampled with telemetry; they screen source starvation but are not a direct acoustic test.

pcm_clock.meaning: Cumulative AudioEffectCapture frames compared with wall-clock expected mix frames. This can localize accumulating capture-clock loss or a discrete gap; it is not measured hardware output latency.

mix_diagnostics.meaning: Engine normalized level and gear roll level are runtime model diagnostics. Both route to the aircraft bus; these estimates do not isolate PCM energy or establish acoustic dominance.

limitations: This continuous straight route uses the research FT-card-v5 takeoff, climb, approach, flare, and rollout laws in one FlightSession. It lands straight ahead on clear terrain beyond the runway; it is not a runway-return circuit. Software evidence is not physical validation, and the aircraft/ground audio remain on a shared bus.
